text: A clinic in the Pak Kret community that has been around for a long time. The doctor is kind, provides good service, and speaks well. I've had my teeth scaled here quite a bit, using social security benefits. But here, we have to pay in advance and then claim insurance ourselves. They charge the full amount, no additional charges like some places. They have all the documents ready for us. The doctor scales well and polishes our teeth when it's finished. I like this place. It might be complicated that we have to pay in advance ourselves, but compared to the service, we are very satisfied.
